question: Which of the following languages is most notably associated with the literary contributions of Girish Karnad, exemplified by his acclaimed play 'Tughlaq'?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kannada**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Girish Karnad** was a renowned Indian playwright, actor, and film director, primarily known for his works in the **Kannada language**.
 
• His acclaimed play **'Tughlaq'**, written in Kannada, is a historical drama that portrays the reign of the 14th-century Sultan of Delhi, **Mohammed bin Tughlaq**.
